name: Mandumah Multi-Doc Agent
description: An agentic RAG system designed to navigate 1.5M Arabic academic documents using a hierarchical meta-agent architecture and graph-based traversal. Optimized for complex linguistic nuances with automated summarization tools.

images.alt: Mandumah Multi-Doc Agent — Initial application view
images.caption: Initial application view

blocks.text: This project involved developing an advanced agentic RAG system for a major Saudi Arabian academic platform to navigate a corpus of 1.5 million documents. It focuses on extracting insights from unstructured Arabic textual data using a hierarchical meta-agent architecture.

items: Architecture: Implemented a hierarchical meta-agent using graph-based traversal to orchestrate document-level agents.
Technical Innovation: Engineered tool-calling mechanisms for real-time Arabic summarization and query answering.
Scaling: Optimized performance for large-scale Arabic text, handling morphological complexity and right-to-left scripting.

name: High-Scale Email Verification System
description: Multi-layered validation pipeline utilizing DNS resolution, SMTP probing, and heuristics to reduce verification costs by 90%. Supports concurrent processing of hundreds of thousands of emails.

blocks.text: Designed as a cost-effective alternative to commercial services, this system processes hundreds of thousands of email addresses with extreme concurrency. It utilizes a multi-layered validation pipeline to ensure high deliverability for large-scale cold outreach campaigns.

items: Cost Efficiency: Built a high-concurrency pipeline that reduced verification costs by 90% compared to commercial services.
Verification Pipeline: Developed multi-layered checks including DNS resolution, SMTP probing, and deliverability heuristics.
Scale: Leveraged asynchronous workers and distributed task queues to process hundreds of thousands of emails concurrently.
Feature Addition: Created an email-guessing module to generate and validate probable corporate email permutations.
